blocking_finding.reading: the behind relationship assumed by V3.1A is not a useful mirror of the ahead relationship; the follower generally has not crossed lap N at target state T, so its same-lap crossing lies in the future

observation_age_level.rejected_because: not a gap: age = follower lap time minus true gap; inverse/confounded semantics; dominated by lap-time scale; sign convention flipped

observation_age_slope_l5.rejected_because: slope of a confounded level inherits the confounding; closing question covered by last-gap slope with consistent sign

observation_age_staleness.use: staleness companion to the last-gap level (provenance, never the gap)

relative_pace_overlap.why: contracted relative trajectories are target-vs-predecessor and target-vs-field; no follower-relative trajectory exists

traffic_overlap.why: in_traffic_2s is ahead-gap-only (<= 2.0 s same-lap ahead); nearby_cars_within_5s requires same observed lap, which the follower almost never shares at T

validity_flag.why: presence/geometry information retained by dyn_follower_lap_diff non-null; per-reason flags forbidden by missingness contract

causal_explanation: At target crossing T (lap-N state just established), the predecessor normally crossed lap N earlier (historical, 171,563 same-lap), while the follower normally has not crossed lap N yet (151,094 still on lap N-1). Predecessor lap-N timing is historical at T; follower lap-N timing lies in the future. Using the follower's eventual same-lap crossing would require information after T. This is an observation-timing property, not ordinary missing data.

entry_gate.detail: see correction document Entry gate section

independent_reproduction.auditor: independent cohort-grouped snapshot script (no V3.1B calculator imports)
independent_reproduction.note: same-lap 4 vs V3.1B 3 and predecessor 171,565 vs 171,563 differ only by exact same-T tie handling (sequential vs cohort-grouped); substance identical

invalid_v1_features.dyn_gap_behind_seconds: INVALID_CAUSALLY: same-lap-at-T interval is unobservable by construction (3/189420 finite); the three values are causal but the concept cannot form a feature
invalid_v1_features.dyn_gap_behind_seconds_valid: VALID_BUT_DEGENERATE: near-constant False under v1; redundant under v2 (presence carried by lap-diff non-null)
invalid_v1_features.dyn_gap_behind_slope_l5: INVALID_CAUSALLY: all-NaN (0/189420); trajectory over a base concept that never forms

selected_correction.form: latest causally observed follower gap F - T_at_F under strict predecessor check + same-lap + non-red gating; H5 OLS over same-follower same-regime runs with uniform target-side masking
selected_correction.rationale: genuine gap semantics (seconds, >= 0), 71.9% coverage stable across seasons/stages, consistent slope sign with ahead slopes, no overlap with relative-pace/traffic, no future estimation, no spatial workaround
